info.title: TaskFlow API
info.description: TaskFlow sharing contract. Errors use {error:{code,message}}. Bearer Session identifies user; every operation checks current project access. Nonmembers receive 404; members attempting owner-only operations receive 403. One owner per project, other participants are members. Only task creators may move/unassign tasks. X-Request-ID accompanies responses. Validation uses 400, not 422. Use HTTPS outside loopback. No cookie authentication. Unknown routes 404; unsupported methods 405. Paths match exactly. Security baseline: all responses no-store/nosniff, production requires trusted HTTPS and an exact same origin; no CORS grants. Requests have a 10s context deadline and 64KiB body limit (auth 4KiB). Per-peer and global in-memory throttles return 429 RATE_LIMITED, Retry-After: 60.

get.description: Visible tasks: private unclassified tasks created by caller, plus tasks in projects currently owned by or shared with caller. Every page rechecks membership; old cursors never grant access. Array response; X-Next-Cursor omitted when exhausted. Cursor is bound to user and filters. Not a snapshot. Authentication accepts either Bearer or the session cookie, never both. Cookie writes require a matching Origin and X-CSRF-Token.

get.summary: List private tasks planned for today
get.description: Read-only Amsterdam day snapshot at request acceptance. No cleanup or task generation. project_id and plan_date filters are rejected. A cursor from a different business date returns 400 INVALID_QUERY. Completed tasks remain until the day changes. Re-fetch after next_day_at; requests accepted before midnight may finish after it and still describe the previous date. Authentication accepts either Bearer or the session cookie, never both. Cookie writes require a matching Origin and X-CSRF-Token.

post.summary: Create a private task planned for today
post.description: The submitted plan_date is only an optimistic date check, not an arbitrary date assignment. Server acceptance time sets both date and created_at. Yesterday/future dates return 409 PLAN_DAY_CHANGED; malformed dates return 400. A request accepted before midnight can commit after midnight as a historical task; refresh using returned plan_date. No project or scheduling support. Authentication accepts either Bearer or the session cookie, never both. Cookie writes require a matching Origin and X-CSRF-Token.

delete.summary: Revoke one of your active sessions
delete.description: Only the authenticated owner can revoke an active session. Missing, expired, revoked and other-user targets all return 404. Cookie writes require a matching Origin and CSRF token. Revoking the current browser session clears its Cookie. No body.

post.summary: Change password and revoke every session
post.description: Requires the current password. JSON limited to 4096 bytes, unknown fields rejected. New password uses the existing registration policy. Hashing occurs outside the transaction; credential version and requesting session are rechecked under the user-row lock. Commit atomically changes the hash/version and revokes ALL sessions including the current one. Sign in again; no new session is issued. Wrong current password returns 400; concurrent credential changes return 409 (or 401 if authentication already sees revocation). Per-process budget 30/global and 5/direct-peer attempts per minute; proxy IP headers cannot bypass it.

csrfToken.description: Session-bound token returned by browser login/bootstrap, required with a matching Origin for cookie-authenticated mutations. Not a login credential.

email.description: Trimmed and lowercased; common unquoted ASCII address, 3–254 bytes.

password.description: 8–128 Unicode characters, at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, not whitespace-only.

access_token.description: Opaque revocable session credential, not a JWT.

id.description: Opaque task identifier; do not assume UUID formatting.

can_move.description: True only for the creator of an ordinary (plan_date=null) task. Planned tasks cannot join projects.

recurrence_id.description: Read-only source rule; null for manual tasks.

CreateTask.description: Title must contain non-whitespace text. Missing/null project_id means unclassified. Due dates must be RFC3339 within years 1–9999.

UpdateTask.description: At least one effective update is required. due_date/project_id: missing preserves, null clears, value sets. Other null fields preserve. Current version required; success increments it once, stale version gives 409. Title cannot be blank. plan_date is read-only and rejected if supplied. Non-null project_id for a planned task returns 400 INVALID_TASK.

name.description: Trim before validation; 1–100 Unicode characters after trimming, no NUL.
Trimmed, 1–100 characters; null/missing preserves, no NUL.

description.description: Null/missing preserves; empty string clears; no NUL.

UpdateProject.description: At least one non-null field. Same-field concurrent edits use last-write-wins; projects have no version.

token.description: Returned only once on creation. Do not log or persist. Share as URL fragment.

plan_date.description: Date displayed by GET /tasks/today. Must match Amsterdam date at server acceptance; otherwise 409 PLAN_DAY_CHANGED.

CreateTodayTask.description: Creates a private task for today. No project_id, owner_id or recurrence fields are accepted, including null. No automatic deletion at midnight.

next_cursor.description: Empty when exhausted; otherwise same value as X-Next-Cursor.

next_day_at.description: Next Amsterdam midnight as a UTC instant; not necessarily 24 hours later.

reminder_enabled.description: Enable Discord reminders for generated occurrences; requires a bound channel.

CreateRecurrence.description: Amsterdam first day must be today or future. Every N civil days. No tasks are generated until Lesson 32 scheduler is enabled.

reminder_enabled.description: Enable Discord reminders for generated occurrences; requires a bound channel.

UpdateRecurrence.description: At least one field required. Omitted/null optional fields preserve values. Changing interval requires anchor_date; any supplied anchor_date must be strictly after Amsterdam today. Changes affect future instances only. Resume skips past dates and respects existing receipts. Version conflict returns 409.

reminder_enabled.description: Enable Discord reminders for generated occurrences; requires a bound channel.

Recurrence.description: next_run_date is a persisted cursor, not a promise of execution. preview_dates is the next up to five aligned dates from max(today,next_run_date), or empty when paused. Source rule deletion never deletes tasks.

scheduler_enabled.description: Whether this API process has the recurrence scheduler enabled; not a guarantee of worker health. Default false.

code.description: One-time bearer secret, shown only in this response. Never log or persist in browser storage.

DiscordInteraction.description: Discord signed raw JSON. Verify timestamp + original bytes before parsing. Not a browser API.

expires_at.description: Absolute expiry; bootstrap does not extend it.

csrf_token.description: CSRF token only; cannot authenticate without the HttpOnly session cookie. Keep in memory.

current.description: Whether this is the requesting session. No IP address, device fingerprint, token or hash is returned.

next_cursor.description: Opaque owner-bound cursor; empty when there is no next page. Not an authentication credential.

current_password.description: Current password, at most 512 UTF-8 bytes.

new_password.description: Same policy as registration: 8–128 Unicode characters, at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, not all whitespace; no trimming.
